final: WITH fee_groups AS (SELECT o.timespan, AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_count FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(fee_count) AS avg_count FROM fee_groups) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio), SUM(g.fee_count), AVG(g.fee_count - a.avg_count) FROM fee_groups AS g CROSS JOIN group_average AS a WHERE g.fee_count > a.avg_count
